breach_id.description: With assessed, when personal data was involved: the breach recorded in the breach register (recordBreach).

note.description: What was found or done. Never a secret, a token, a full NRIC or a bank number (SEC-15).
examples: Removed the session; the Owner confirmed the new laptop by phone.

step.description: The step: contained, assessed, notified (after assessed), recovered (after contained), reviewed (after recovered; it closes the incident).
